candidates: When merging a user-supplied options object with defaults using spread syntax, avoid the anti-pattern `{ ...userOptions, key: userOptions?.key || defaultValue }` — it redundantly re-reads a property that the spread already copied. Instead use the defaults-first / spread-last pattern `{ key: defaultValue, ...userOptions }` so user-provided values naturally override defaults without any explicit re-reading of individual properties from the same source object.
